settings.subheading: Not literally — but that's where the idea was born.
settings.body: My son was diagnosed with a heart condition. The hospital was cold. I reached for something soft. Something steady. 8.9 oz organic cotton fleece, brushed soft inside. A small heart at the chest. “Soft Strength” stitched down the left sleeve. It didn’t exist. So I made it.

settings.text: 30-Day Comfort Guarantee — If it doesn’t feel right, I’ll make it right.

settings.quote: I didn’t set out to build a brand. I made this for the hard days. Mine first. Then everyone else’s.

settings.title: A small mark near yours.
settings.description: A small embroidered heart at the left chest. The quiet knowing that you’re not the only one holding it all together.

settings.title: Soft Strength on the left sleeve.
settings.description: “Soft Strength” embroidered in white thread on the left sleeve. Intentional. Not decorative. Something you notice when you need to.

settings.title: 8.9oz. Heavyweight, intentionally.
settings.description: GOTS certified organic cotton fleece. Substantial in your hands. Super soft brushed lining inside. Made to be felt, not just worn.

settings.short_description: 8.9 oz organic cotton fleece. A super soft brushed lining inside. A small embroidered heart at the chest, and “Soft Strength” in white thread on the left sleeve.
settings.features: 8.9 oz organic cotton fleece, super soft inside | “Soft Strength” embroidered on the left sleeve in white thread | Embroidered heart detail, left chest | Waist-length with dropped shoulders | Ribbed cuffs, collar & hem | GOTS certified organic cotton | 30-day comfort guarantee
settings.specs: Fabric: 8.9 oz organic fleece | Lining: Brushed fleece inside | Certification: GOTS certified organic | Construction: Dropped shoulder, ribbed cuffs

settings.title: Give Comfort
settings.body: A hoodie you buy for yourself. A hoodie you send to someone who needs it. Add a private gift note at checkout. Have it shipped straight to them. No pricing, no packing slip. Just something soft, arriving when the day was hard.

settings.title: Letters from Ali
settings.body: A short note, once a month. New pieces, the people wearing them, what I’m thinking about. No noise, no urgency — you can leave whenever you like.
